title: inventory.reservation.expired — Payload Schema
description: Emitted by erp.inventory when a reservation's TTL elapses without the order receiving a confirmed payment. The reserved units are returned to aggregate_available. erp.inventory also emits a corresponding inventory.stock.updated message. Commerce must cancel or re-queue the order and notify the buyer.

reservation_id.description: Identifier of the reservation that expired.

order_id.description: Identifier of the Commerce order whose reservation has expired.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core.

location_id.description: Location from which the units were released back to available.

quantity.description: Number of units returned to aggregate_available.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the TTL expiry was processed by erp.inventory.
